build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Primary mechanic A is complete and playable: Hero selection and roster system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanic B is complete and connected to A: Ability and cooldown system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanics C and D both affect live play: Objective-based match modes; Team role system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

At least four supporting systems are implemented and connected: Hero roster with per-hero weapon, abilities, and stats; Cooldown and ultimate charge system; Role system: tank, damage, support; Control point ownership and capture progress system; Payload escort movement and blocking system; Respawn wave timer; Hero select screen with team composition view; Match replay and stat summary. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

Provide at least three enemy archetypes, weapon or ability tradeoffs, escalating waves or spaces, readable damage and ammunition state, and a final objective with victory, defeat, and retry. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The rules layer maintains resources, objectives, selection, danger, progress, and outcome without relying on DOM text as the source of truth. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

A three-stage progression teaches the core mechanic, combines systems under greater pressure, and ends with a mastery scenario plus a working replay flow. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

Important actions have immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state changes. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled start flow, playable systems, escalation, final success/failure state, and retry navigation work without page reload. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: Readable targets and projectiles, disciplined muzzle and impact effects, strong cover silhouettes, useful depth cues, and camera treatment that supports aiming. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The 3D first-person composition uses deliberate lighting, contrast, depth or layering, and themed landmarks instead of an empty default scene. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Interactive actors, targets, hazards, tools, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or synchronized audio feedback. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
